fields.description: Issue includes editorials and reports on Miami municipal finances and governance, including criticism of budget cuts alongside city purchases and an affidavit seeking recall of the city commission. Coverage also addresses Dade County public-instruction budget shortfalls and proposed reductions in teaching staff, local enforcement of prohibition and related corruption concerns, and commentary on crime and policing. A prominent feature discusses stage performer Gene Dennis and claims about the McAllister kidnapping, alongside other local civic notes, society/column items, and advertisements for Miami-area businesses and entertainment.
